title: Cory Mills slapped with restraining order after Florida judge sides with accuser
notes: Chosen from New Gray's ranked list of three reports of the order (Politico, NBC News, ABC News) as the first that Wayback holds and that passes the read-only check; the other two were not read. The capture, of 02:39:18 UTC on 2025-10-15, is the one Wayback served for 2025-10-14 at the story's address; it prints 10/14/2025 05:20 PM EDT (21:20 UTC), datelined TALLAHASSEE, Florida, and quotes the court's judgment that it "does not find [Mills'] testimony concerning the intimate videos to be truthful". It puts the order on Tuesday, which its print date makes 2025-10-14. Its address was found in Yahoo's carry of the story, which credits Politico. Not read live: politico.com's robots.txt answered 403 on 2026-11-05.
